summary: Completed the 3D Loveverse upgrade with an Explorable Partner Walk mode, solid sliding collision detection system (preventing users from walking through walls, balustrades, obstacles, or water perimeters), high-fidelity procedural models recreating all Sketchfab inspirations (Ever Tide beach diorama, pier, crates, barrels, lanterns, boat, bench, umbrella, toon plane; Paris Haussmann facades, Cafe OZ awning, streetlamps, Arc de Triomphe, Eiffel Tower; Museum gallery hall, ornate gold picture frames, velvet viewing benches; Kitty Letter chibi cat and cozy bedroom), virtual touch joystick and WASD/arrow controls, and an in-app CC BY 4.0 3D Art Inspirations & Credits modal.
